description: Measures its own width and cascades the resolved TmLayoutMode to its children. Auto registers a shared ResizeObserver and reports a change only when the mode changes; a forced Desktop, Tablet or Mobile never imports the observer, and neither does Auto under a forced ancestor. The root carries tm-layout, tm-layout--{mode} and data-layout, which Blazor renders — the script never writes them.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto measures the root unless a forced ancestor has decided. Desktop, Tablet or Mobile force that layout and skip the observer.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered mode changes. The initial value is not a change. Never pair LayoutMode with this callback: it reports the resolved mode, and a two-way bind would pin that mode.

parameters.name: LayoutContent
parameters.description: Content that receives the resolved layout. Use it instead of ChildContent when the owner must branch its own markup. Setting both throws.

parameters.name: IsViewportScope
parameters.description: Also cascades the context under the name TmLayoutScopes.Viewport, so an overlay can ask for the viewport layout rather than the container the trigger sits in.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content rendered inside the observed container. The resolved layout is cascaded as TmLayoutContext, so a child reads it with a CascadingParameter.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes appended to the root.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: Inline style appended to the root.

parameters.name: IsContainer
parameters.description: When false the root does not establish a containment context. Shrink-to-fit hosts such as a popover pass false.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The mode rendered before the first measurement: static SSR, prerender and the first frame.
